comment.text: These bots behave like backfill. Maximum supported is 100. They will populate unused server slots up to 100. If you set the teams to 32v32 and you set this to 100, then 36 bots will join. If you set the teams to 1v1 then 98 bots will join. Recommended maximum 60 for server performance.
